info.title: API.SH: Dutchie
info.description: The Dutchie API from API.SH: public Dutchie data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
Every US state and Canadian province where Dutchie lists dispensaries, with the cities that have them and each city's Dutchie page. Use a city and state in the dispensaries endpoint.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dutchie-cities

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: US or CA.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Two-letter state or province code, e.g. CO or ON.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A dispensary's menu collections (curated lists such as new drops or staff picks): id, slug, title, description, product count, navigation title, badge, image, link and the `collection_id` to list its products in the menu endpoint.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dutchie-collections

parameters.name: dispensary
parameters.description: The dispensary's Dutchie slug (as in dutchie.com/dispensary/<slug>), its id, or a dutchie.com dispensary link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Licensed dispensaries on Dutchie in a city, near coordinates within a radius (sorted by distance), or of one chain, with open-now, pickup, delivery, recreational and medical filters. Each dispensary: id, slug, name, link, chain, status, recreational and medical flags, pickup, curbside and delivery, delivery radius, distance, address, coordinates, phone, time zone, pickup and delivery hours, ready-time estimates, image and logo. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dutchie-dispensaries

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name (with state), as in the cities endpoint.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Two-letter state or province code (with city).

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude (with lng), instead of city.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude (with lat).

parameters.name: radius_miles
parameters.description: Radius in miles around lat/lng (1-100, default 15).

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: A chain slug (the `chain` field), alone or with a place.

parameters.name: open_now
parameters.description: true: only dispensaries open for pickup now.

parameters.name: pickup
parameters.description: true: only dispensaries with pickup.

parameters.name: delivery
parameters.description: true: only dispensaries that deliver; false: none that do.

parameters.name: recreational
parameters.description: true: recreational (adult-use) dispensaries; false: medical-only.

parameters.name: medical
parameters.description: true: medical dispensaries.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1 = first).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Dispensaries per page (1-100, default 25).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

dispensaries.name: The 720Rec
dispensaries.address: 2949 W Alameda Ave, Denver, CO 80219, USA

get.description:
One Dutchie dispensary: name, chain, status, address, coordinates, phone, business email, description, menu categories, recreational and medical, pickup, curbside and delivery, order types, pickup and delivery hours, holiday hours, ready-time estimates, accepted payment types, cash/debit-only flags, delivery fee tiers, photo-ID rules, announcement, website menu link, images and `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dutchie-dispensary

parameters.name: dispensary
parameters.description: The dispensary's Dutchie slug (as in dutchie.com/dispensary/<slug>), its id, or a dutchie.com dispensary link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.address: 1530 South Alameda Street, Los Angeles, CA 90021, USA

get.description:
A dispensary's live Dutchie menu with every filter the menu has: category, subcategory, strain type, brand, effects, search words, size, on special, one special, one collection, price range and THC/CBD range, recreational or medical pricing, and 10 sorts. Each product: id, slug, name, link, brand, category, subcategory, strain type, THC, CBD and total terpenes, cannabinoids, effects, every size with price, special price, medical prices and quantity available, lowest price, specials, medical/recreational only, rating, images, lab results link, featured flag and dates. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dutchie-menu

parameters.name: dispensary
parameters.description: The dispensary's Dutchie slug (as in dutchie.com/dispensary/<slug>), its id, or a dutchie.com dispensary link.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Comma list of categories.

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: Comma list of subcategories as the store names them, e.g. infused, live-resin.

parameters.name: strain_type
parameters.description: Comma list: indica, sativa, hybrid, high-cbd, indica-hybrid, sativa-hybrid.

parameters.name: brand_id
parameters.description: Comma list of brand ids (the `brand_id` field).

parameters.name: effects
parameters.description: Comma list, e.g. calm, happy, relaxed, energetic, sleepy, creative, focused, inspired, uplifted.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words within the menu.

parameters.name: option
parameters.description: One size, e.g. 1/8oz or 1g.

parameters.name: on_special
parameters.description: true: only products on a special.

parameters.name: special_id
parameters.description: Only products of this special (an id from the specials endpoint).

parameters.name: collection_id
parameters.description: Only products of this collection (an id from the collections endpoint).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price.

parameters.name: thc_min
parameters.description: Minimum THC (percent by default).

parameters.name: thc_max
parameters.description: Maximum THC.

parameters.name: cbd_min
parameters.description: Minimum CBD.

parameters.name: cbd_max
parameters.description: Maximum CBD.

parameters.name: potency_unit
parameters.description: Unit of the THC/CBD filters: percent (default) or mg.

parameters.name: pricing
parameters.description: rec (default) or med prices.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default: the store's featured order).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1 = first).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page (1-50, default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One product on a dispensary's Dutchie menu, by id, slug or dutchie.com product link: everything the menu returns plus the description, brand description and logo, terpenes (amount, aromas, effects), cannabinoids, lab results per size, net weight or volume, purchase limits and `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dutchie-product

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Product id or slug, or a full dutchie.com product link (then dispensary is optional).

parameters.name: dispensary
parameters.description: The dispensary's Dutchie slug (as in dutchie.com/dispensary/<slug>), its id, or a dutchie.com dispensary link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A dispensary's current specials and deals: id, name, description, type (sale, bogo, bundle...), recreational/medical menu, percent or amount off, target price, start and end, recurring days, image, rank, link and the `special_id` to list its products in the menu endpoint.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dutchie-specials

parameters.name: dispensary
parameters.description: The dispensary's Dutchie slug (as in dutchie.com/dispensary/<slug>), its id, or a dutchie.com dispensary link.

parameters.name: menu_type
parameters.description: Only specials for this menu: rec, med or both.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
